_about: crypto-trader-skill settings. Copy to crypto/config.json (python3 crypto-setup/setup.py init) and edit. Keys starting with _ are notes.
_data: Where prices come from. auto tries Binance, then Bybit, then Hyperliquid, and keeps the first that answers from your location.
_money: Your account and your limits. Every order passes crypto-risk against these before it can go anywhere.
_leverage: Leverage and margin. Isolated margin limits a loss to the margin you put up for that one position.
_costs: Fees in basis points (0.01%). Leave null to use the venue's base rate.
_orders: paper true simulates fills at live prices against the real order book. Live orders need paper false, your own keys in environment variables, a PASS from crypto-risk and your typed yes.
